title: The Woman of My Life
text: The Woman of My Life There is a woman in my life,soft as morning light,yet strong enough to hold my world together. She feeds my body when emptiness calls,and feeds my heart when the world feels cold.Even when life turns its back on me,she remains—constant, unshaken, whole. Her love is not something that can be bought,nor replaced,not even by the richest treasures of the earth. She shaped my first steps,and built my becoming with patient hands.In every part of me,there is a piece of her sacrifice. To compare her with anotherwould be to forget what love truly means,for no one can take her place. She is the star in my night sky,the warmth in my coldest hours,the quiet strength behind my every rise. My mothermy forever hero.

He goes on to explain that the pressure to live up to unrealistic online lifestyles has left many young people battling anxiety, low self-esteem, and emotional stress. Academic performance, he adds, has also suffered as students spend more time scrolling through feeds than turning the pages of their books. To Mukisa, the conclusion is obvious: social media should be reserved for adults who are mature enough to use it responsibly. title: THE LONG RIDE

title: Mentorship 2026
text: Mentorship is a supportive relationship in which an experienced person (the mentor) guides, advises, and encourages a less experienced person (the mentee) to grow personally, academically, or professionally. It is a powerful way of transferring knowledge, values, skills, and life experiences from one generation to another. A good mentorship programme helps individuals discover their strengths, overcome challenges, and develop confidence. Through regular interaction, mentors share their experiences, offer advice, and help mentees make informed decisions about their studies, careers, and personal lives. Mentorship also creates a safe environment where mentees can ask questions, seek guidance, and learn from the successes and mistakes of others.

title: Mentoring young citizens
text: Mentoring is a developmental process in which a more experienced or knowledgeable person provides guidance, advice, and support to another person who wants to grow personally, academically, or professionally. The experienced person is called a mentor, while the person receiving guidance is known as a mentee. Mentoring focuses on sharing knowledge, experiences, and skills in order to help the mentee learn, improve, and achieve their goals. It is built on trust, communication, and mutual respect between the mentor and the mentee.

title: An Organized Students’ Leadership Body
text: An organized students’ leadership body is essential for promoting order, unity, and effective communication within a school. It is made up of committed student leaders who work together in a structured system to support the administration and represent the interests of the student community. In such a leadership body, roles are clearly defined from the Head Prefect and deputies to class prefects and committee leaders. Each member understands their responsibilities, ensuring that duties are carried out efficiently and consistently. This clarity of roles helps avoid confusion and promotes accountability among student leaders. An organized students’ leadership body operates through teamwork, discipline, and mutual respect. Regular meetings are held to plan activities, address challenges, and share ideas. Through these discussions, leaders are able to coordinate school programs, maintain discipline, and ensure smooth running of daily school activities.

title: Leaders in action
text: School assemblies provide an important platform for student leaders to communicate, guide, and inspire the entire student body. When leaders address assembly, they take on the responsibility of representing the voice of the students while upholding the values and standards of the school.
